urgent.heading: Ingxamisekile — sebenzisa i-EpiPen ngoku
urgent.primary_message: Sebenzisa i-adrenaline auto-injector (EpiPen) ngoko nangoko ethangeni langaphandle. Emva koko Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177.
red_flags: Ukudumba kobuso, imilebe, ulwimi okanye umqala
Ubunzima bokuphefumla, ukuvutha kwesifuba okanye umqala oqinayo
Amachokoza arhawuzelayo okanye amabala abomvu asasazeka emzimbeni
Ukubetha kwentliziyo ngokukhawuleza, isiyezi okanye ukuwa isiqaqa
Ukugabha, iintlungu ezinzima zesisu okanye urhudo ngesiquphe

what_is_it.heading: I-anaphylaxis ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: I-anaphylaxis kukuphendula kakhulu komzimba wonke kwi-allergy, okunokubulala ngemizuzu ukuba akunyangwanga.
paragraphs: Yenzeka xa amajoni omzimba ephendula kakhulu kwinto edla ngokungabi yingozi — ukutya, ulwamvila, iyeza okanye i-latex. Imithambo yegazi iyavuza, iindlela zomoya ziyadumba, uxinzelelo lwegazi luyehla.

I-adrenaline (epinephrine) lolona nyango lokuqala olubalulekileyo. I-auto-injector efana ne-EpiPen ilufaka kwisihlunu sethanga. Ii-antihistamine neepompi zokuphefumla azithathi indawo yayo. Emva kokusebenzisa i-EpiPen, umntu usadinga ukunyanyekelwa esibhedlele kuba iimpawu zinokubuya emva kweeyure.

items.headline: Imizuzu
items.body: I-anaphylaxis enzima ingabulala ngaphakathi kwemizuzu eli-15. Isantya sonyango sibaluleke kakhulu.

items.headline: Izinto eziyivusayo
items.body: Amandongomane, ii-tree nuts, ukutya kwaselwandle, intlanzi, ubisi, amaqanda, ulwamvila lweenyosi okanye lwe-wasp, amayeza (rhoqo ii-antibiotic), kunye ne-latex.

items.headline: Isiqendu sesibini
items.body: Kufikelela kumntu omnye kwabahlanu abaphinda babe nempendulo yesibini emva kweeyure ezi-4–12, nokuba bebesele bengcono. Ukujongwa esibhedlele kubalulekile.

items.headline: I-EpiPen kuqala
items.body: I-adrenaline auto-injector lolona nyango lokuqala. Ikhuselekile ukuyisebenzisa — ukungayisebenzisi yeyona nto ibangela umonakalo.

pull_quote.text: Ukuba awuqinisekanga ukuba yi-anaphylaxis na — sebenzisa i-EpiPen kunjalo. Umngcipheko wokuyisebenzisa ngokungeyomfuneko mncinci. Umngcipheko wokungayisebenzisi ungabulala.

signs.heading: Into onokuyibona
signs.lede: I-anaphylaxis idla ngokuqala ngemizuzu emva kokuchanabeka. Iimpawu zibandakanya ngaphezu kwenkqubo enye yomzimba — ulusu, ukuphefumla, ukujikeleza kwegazi okanye isisu.

items.title: Ulusu
items.description: Amachokoza arhawuzelayo okanye amabala abomvu, ukurhawuzelela kakhulu, ukufudumala nokubomvu, ukudumba kobuso, imilebe, ulwimi okanye amehlo.

items.title: Ukuphefumla
items.description: Ukuvutha kwesifuba, umqala oqinayo, ilizwi elirhabaxa, ubunzima bokuginya, ukukhohlela okungapheliyo, ukutsala nzima ukuphefumla.

items.title: Ukujikeleza kwegazi
items.description: Ukubetha kwentliziyo ngokukhawuleza, uxinzelelo lwegazi olusezantsi, isiyezi, ukuwa isiqaqa, ulusu oluphaphathekileyo okanye olubandayo olunamathelayo, ukuwa.

items.title: Isisu kunye nokuziva jikelele
items.description: Iintlungu zesisu, ukugabha, urhudo ngesiquphe. Ukuziva ngathi kukho into embi kakhulu ezayo luphawu olwamkelwayo lwesilumkiso.

items.fact: Ii-antihistamine zinceda kwiimpawu ezithambileyo ze-allergy. Azikwazi ukubuyisela umva i-anaphylaxis. I-adrenaline lolona nyango lokuqala.

items.myth: Kufuneka ndilinde ndibone ukuba iba mandundu na ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-EpiPen.
items.fact: Yisebenzise nje xa i-anaphylaxis ikrokrelwa. Ukulibazisa sesona sizathu sixhaphakileyo sokufa. I-adrenaline ikhuselekile — ukuyibamba kuyingozi.

items.myth: Ukuba uziva ngcono emva kwe-EpiPen, akusafuneki aye esibhedlele.
items.fact: Usadinga ukujongwa esibhedlele. Iimpawu zinokubuya emva kweeyure (biphasic reaction). Kungadingeka i-EpiPen yesibini.

items.myth: Ufuna i-EpiPen kuphela ukuba wakhe waba nempendulo enzima ngaphambili.
items.fact: Impendulo enzima yokuqala inokufika ngaphandle kwesilumkiso, ngakumbi kubantu abaziwayo ukuba bane-allergy yokutya okanye yezinambuzane. Thetha nogqirha malunga nokufumana i-EpiPen.

items.title: Sebenzisa i-EpiPen ethangeni langaphandle
items.description: Ingasetyenziswa nangaphezulu kweempahla. Yibambe ngokuqinileyo imizuzwana eli-10. Qaphela ixesha oyisebenzise ngalo.

items.title: Tsalela umnxeba ku-10177 okanye ku-112 ngoko nangoko
items.description: Yithi 'anaphylaxis'. Nokuba umntu ubonakala engcono, usadinga ukujongwa esibhedlele.

items.title: Mlalise tyaba, uphakamise imilenze
items.description: Oku kunceda uxinzelelo lwegazi. Ukuba uyagabha, mlalise ngecala. Ukuba ukuphefumla kunzima, mvumele ahlale — angemi.

items.title: I-EpiPen yesibini ukuba akukho phucuko ngemizuzu emi-5
items.description: Nika idosi yesibini kwelinye ithanga. Uninzi lwe-EpiPen luza ngepakethi ezimbini ngenxa yesi sizathu.

items.title: Hlala naye de kufike abeparamedic
items.description: Jonga ukuphefumla nokubetha kwentliziyo. Lungela ukwenza i-CPR. Nika abeparamedic i-EpiPen esetyenzisiweyo.

get_help.heading: Ngubani omawumfowunele ngoku
get_help.lede: I-anaphylaxis isoloko iyimeko engxamisekileyo, nokuba iimpawu ziyathamba emva kwe-EpiPen. Mse esibhedlele.

helplines.name: Uncedo olungxamisekileyo (iselula)
helplines.description: Ifikelela kuyo nayiphi na inkonzo yongxamiseko xa utsalela umnxeba ngeselula
